editorial:
Malcolm thinks he has finally escaped his haunted past when he moves into a dream home with his new girlfriend and her two kids. Instead, strange noises, creepy dolls, and weird neighbors turn everyday life into a nonstop parade of silly scares. The movie leans hard into parody, mixing horror movie cliches with loud, crude jokes and fast-moving chaos. If you enjoy spoof comedies that poke fun at haunted house stories, you will find plenty of goofy moments here.

The cast keeps the energy high, especially when Malcolm reacts with big, panicked expressions to every bump in the night. The pacing rarely slows down, so the jokes come quickly, though some land better than others. It is not subtle, and the humor can feel repetitive, but fans of silly horror spoofs may still have a good time. You can stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, Malcolm confronts the evil force threatening his new family, and the chaos peaks with a wild showdown. The twist reveals that the danger is not fully gone, leaving the door open for more trouble. By the end, Malcolm survives the madness, but the movie makes it clear that his haunted life is far from over, and the family may still face more strange trouble ahead.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves silly horror spoofs and crude comedy.
